verdict.line: You lose trades where you extend into her W (Ki Burst) stun with no answer ready; you win every fight where you land E (Apprehend) to pull her out of her dash chain and stack Hemorrhage to five before she can reset.

brief.thesis: Darius' Hemorrhage passive and true-damage R mean every extra second of a fight is free value for him, while Riven's entire kit is built to win the first two seconds and then leave. The matchup is measured even (49.9% win rate, 2,004 games) because whoever decides when the fight actually starts — her W into Q chain, or your E pull into stacked bleed — usually decides who wins it. Darius holds a real edge once a fight is forced to last, which is why the data shows a clear solo-kill advantage his way despite the coin-flip lane shape.

theirWindow.when: Her W and Q both ready
theirWindow.what: She all-ins with Ki Burst's stun chained into Broken Wings' three hits and empowered Runic Blade autos. Don't walk up to trade here without E (Apprehend) or Q (Decimate) ready to answer immediately.

yourWindow.when: She commits to her third Q
yourWindow.what: Fire E (Apprehend) to pull her out of the Broken Wings sequence before the third-hit knockback lands — this interrupts her disengage and drags her next to you instead. Follow with Q and autos to pile Hemorrhage stacks while she has no E (Valor) block left.

start.why: The dominant start on this patch (90% pick) — the extra AD and sustain let you hold even trades while she's chaining Q and empowered autos.

boots.why: 100% pick rate here — flat reduction on her empowered Runic Blade autos matters more than movement speed in a lane decided by short trades.

core.why: Core first item in the measured build path — the damage, health, and tempo let you threaten all-ins the moment E (Apprehend) is up.
Second in the same path — the shield and bonus AD cover you through her stun-into-burst combo when you're committed to a fight.
Closes out the measured core — the move speed stacking helps you stay on her since she has no hard escape beyond E (Valor)'s short step.

situational.when: you want to win the all-in by level 6-9 instead of scaling past it
she's landing her full W-into-Q combo consistently and you need to survive the burst window
she's ahead and her empowered autos are shredding you faster than you can stack Hemorrhage

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror rewards exactly the extended-trade pattern this lane wants from you — stacking through her Q chain and autos to outheal and outdamage her once the fight passes the first two seconds. Note: master-tier Darius players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) across 352 games — that fits players who want to win the first engage and roam off a reset rather than grind out stacked trades.

summoners.why: The clear measured favorite (60% win rate, 55.6% pick) — Ghost lets you stay stuck to her through her Q dash chain and E (Valor) step so your E/R actually connects, which matters more here than Exhaust or Ignite given neither showed a winning sample.

playing.title: Hook her mid-Q chain
playing.detail: Use E (Apprehend) the instant she commits to her second or third Broken Wings hit — this is the confirmed interrupt point that stops her knockback disengage and locks her into your bleed.

playing.title: Don't walk into a loaded W
playing.detail: If her Ki Burst is off cooldown, hold position — she stuns on contact and chains into empowered autos before your Q even lands.

playing.title: Lean on shrinking Q cooldown
playing.detail: Skill order WEQQQRQEQEREEWW maxes Q fast — Decimate drops from 9s to as low as 5s, so keep threatening it to poke, heal, and bait her Valor block.

playing.title: Punish her spent E (Valor)
playing.detail: Valor's block sits on a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown — once she's used it to step in or block your Q, she has no more damage mitigation until it resets. Commit your all-in here.

playing.title: Hold R for stacked bleed
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks — build to five with autos and Q before casting, and remember the cooldown collapses to 6s at rank 4-5 if the first cast kills.

playing.title: Trust your solo-kill edge
playing.detail: Data shows you hold the solo-kill advantage here despite the even lane shape — take short trades near minions and let Hemorrhage do the closing work instead of forcing a full all-in.

playing.title: Respect an Ignite start
playing.detail: If she's running Ignite, keep extra spacing and track her Conqueror stacks before engaging — your Q sustain needs to outpace her burn, not just her raw damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: If Riven brought Ignite, pay attention to your distance and her Conqueror stacks before engaging combat. Try to interrupt her third (Q) with your [E].
